pin_checkpoint: pin a checkpoint directory so it is excluded from automatic pruning and deletion
unpin_checkpoint: unpin a checkpoint directory to allow it to be deleted during automatic pruning
is_pinned_checkpoint: check whether a checkpoint directory is pinned and should not be removed
remove_checkpoint_dir: remove a checkpoint directory if it is not pinned, otherwise keep it
pinned_checkpoint_filepath: get the full file path of the PINNED marker file for a checkpoint directory
